newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner to redeem $457 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner to redeem $457 mln notes.

text.p: Time Warner Inc said Wednesday it will redeem all $457 million outstanding principal amount of floating rate notes due 2000.
A spokesman said the notes were issued by its Time Warner Cos Inc division.
The redemption date is August 15, and the redemption price per $1,000 principal amount will be $1,000.
The company said interest due on the notes on August 15 will be paid in the usual manner to holders of record of the notes on August 1.
Chase Manhattan Bank, trustee for the floating rate notes, will act as paying agent.
